description.text: The eleventh Sword & Shield set, released on 9 September 2022 with 247 cards, its 30-card Trainer Gallery among them. It brought back the Lost Zone mechanic, led by Giratina VSTAR, and returns to Hisui, with Hisuian Goodra and Hisuian Zoroark VSTAR, Aerodactyl VSTAR, Kyurem VMAX, Enamorus V and Radiant Gardevoir.
